description: Interactive code dependency graph and analysis tool for VS Code. Visualize file imports, symbol call hierarchies, and cross-file call graphs. Detect circular dependencies, dead code, and breaking changes. Supports TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Go, Java, Python, Rust, Vue, Svelte, and GraphQL.

configuration.title: GraphCode
configuration.properties.graphcode.enabl: Enable background indexing for faster reverse dependency lookups, when enabled the extension will index all files in the workspace at startup
configuration.properties.graphcode.preIn: Pre-index the call graph database at startup alongside background indexing, when enabled the first show call graph command is near-instant because the symbol-level index is already built
configuration.properties.graphcode.persi: Persist the dependency index to disk for faster startup, files are validated using mtime and size to detect changes, enable this option only if you have some performance issues on large projects
configuration.properties.graphcode.index: Number of files to process in parallel during background indexing, lower values reduce CPU usage but increase indexing time
Delay in milliseconds before starting background indexing after extension activation, allows VS Code to finish startup first
configuration.properties.graphcode.logLe: Logging level for the extension, debug shows all logs, none disables logging
configuration.properties.graphcode.unuse: Choose how to display unused dependencies in the graph, hide removes them, dim reduces their opacity
configuration.properties.graphcode.perfo: Performance profile preset, default balanced settings, low-memory optimized for machines with less than 4GB RAM, high-performance maximizes speed on powerful machines, custom enables manual configuration of all performance settings
configuration.properties.graphcode.graph: Layout algorithm for graph views (used for file dependency graphs and symbol relationship graphs). Hierarchical top-to-bottom layout is best for call flows, force-directed interactive physics-based layout is best for exploring relationships, radial concentric circles with current file at center is experimental
configuration.properties.graphcode.showR: Show referencing file paths before filename in graph view, when enabled each file node displays a list of files that import or reference it, helping you understand the reverse dependency chain
configuration.properties.graphcode.unuse: Number of source files to analyze in parallel for unused dependency detection, lower values use less memory but are slower, adjust based on your machine capabilities
Skip automatic unused dependency analysis if the graph has more edges than this threshold, set to 0 to disable the limit, manual analysis via toolbar button still works
configuration.properties.graphcode.persi: Cache unused dependency analysis results to disk for faster subsequent loads, results are invalidated when files change
configuration.properties.graphcode.maxUn: Maximum number of source files to cache for unused dependency analysis, uses LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction when limit is reached
configuration.properties.graphcode.maxCa: Maximum number of file dependency analyses to keep in memory cache (LRU cache), lower values reduce memory usage
configuration.properties.graphcode.maxSy: Maximum number of symbol analysis results to keep in memory cache (LRU cache), lower values reduce memory usage
